_schema.PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - process whose action item entity is used for the KPI entity mapping
_schema.SUBPROCESS_NAME: string (required) - fallback entity when the process has no action item entity
_schema.KPI_NAME_PREFIX: string (required) - prefix for the unique attrName/displayName
_schema.KPI_BODY: object (required) - PSR ActionItemKpis1 body; attrName and displayName are set at runtime
_schema.ADDED_ATTRIBUTE: object (required) - attribute added by PUT without an id
_schema.UNKNOWN_ID: string (required) - UUID that is not a KPI
_schema.NOT_FOUND_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for an unknown KPI
_schema.INVALID_JSON_ERROR_CODE: string (required) - errorCode for a malformed JSON body
